
{{alias}}( arr, name, fields )
    Converts an array of arrays to a "tidy" data set.

    The function assumes that all nested arrays have the same length.

    The number of field names should equal the length of each nested array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arr: ArrayLikeObject<ArrayLikeObject>
        Input array containing nested arrays.

    name: string
        Data set name.

    fields: Array<string>
        List of field names.

    Returns
    -------
    out: DataSet
        Data set instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ];
    > var out = {{alias}}( x, 'data', [ 'x', 'y' ] )
    <DataSet>

    See Also
    --------
